messages:
Anya: Quick follow-up from last night's incident 11 recurring pattern: missing spans + aggregation drift during the ETL window. Need owners, timelines, and short-term mitigations.
ops-bot: Incident logged: INC-2026-0423-37 11 alerts for span-loss and aggregator backlog triggered; #eng-oncall notified.
Mike: Looked at consumer metrics. Consumer lag spiked ~02:10 UTC; downstream reprocessing flooded the aggregator and hit transient resource limits.
Sarah: Root cause appears to be the session_id bucketing change that created hot partitioning. Several partitions received ~10x expected traffic, causing KV cache thrashes and dropped spans.
Leo: I can take the partitioning fix: revert the bucketing tweak and implement sticky hashing to spread load. ETA: 48h dev + 24h canary. Assigning to @Leo.
Anya: Leo 11 please add a load-sim test to validate distribution and a dashboard showing hot-shard metrics. Owner=Leo, due=1965200000, status=todo.
AnalyticsOwner: I'll own aggregation correctness: implement per-batch checksums and a nightly diff job comparing aggregator output to source-of-truth. Owner=AnalyticsOwner, due=1965300000, status=todo.
Mike: Short-term mitigation applied: increased consumer parallelism and enabled buffering to smooth bursts. Applied to staging; monitoring now. Owner=Mike, planned done=1965131500.
Sarah: Also found sampler was silently dropping trace roots when payload >512KB; that removed some high-impact spans. Raised sampler limit and added explicit logging for dropped traces. PR: https://git.re/infra/trace/patches/432 (owner=Sarah).
Leo: Detection additions: alert when span-drop-rate >0.1% over 5m and when aggregator divergence >3c3. Will update ops runbook with rollback/playbook steps.
Anya: Action recap (short):
- Leo: sticky hashing, load-sim test, hot-shard dashboard (owner=Leo)
- AnalyticsOwner: per-batch checksums + nightly diff job (owner=AnalyticsOwner)
- Mike: consumer parallelism bump + buffering (owner=Mike)
- Sarah: sampler limit increase + logging PR (owner=Sarah)
- Eng-oncall: temporary alert thresholds + runbook edits
Please drop PR/CL links in the shared follow-up doc and update the spreadsheet column "remediation_ts" when each item is complete.
Mike: Config snippet used for staging: ```
kafka.consumers=24
batch.size.ms=50
enable.buffering=true
```
Mike: Staging looks stable so far; will continue to monitor and post updates in ~3h.
AnalyticsOwner: Note on timelines: full checksum job needs infra scanning 7 days of windows 11 estimate 3d infra + 2d testing. Can ship a smoke check first and defer full rollout to next sprint if necessary.
Leo: Proposal: owner-reminder automation. If a remediation ticket has no updates for 72h, GH action opens a Slack thread pinging the owner + me. I'll draft the action. Owner=Leo, PR due=1965180000.
ops-bot: Follow-up meeting scheduled at 1965183600 UTC 11 agenda: deployment plan, validation checks, rollback criteria.
Sarah: Doc req: add a postmortem subsection "recurring-span-loss" with a sample diagnostic query.
Anya: Sample diagnostic query for docs: ```
SELECT trace_id, count(*) AS span_count
FROM spans
WHERE timestamp >= now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY trace_id
HAVING count(*) < 3
ORDER BY span_count ASC
LIMIT 100
```
AnalyticsOwner: I'll integrate that query into the nightly diff as a quick sanity check.
Leo: Creating sticky-hash branch now; will post PR when tests pass.
Mike: Consumer bump applied to staging; no regressions detected. Will promote to prod if stable in 6h.
Anya: Thanks everyone 11 reconvene after the follow-up meeting. If you hit blockers, post a one-line update in this thread :thumbsup:
